Hello Niddana  Apurva .,


Thank you for registering for the JNCAA -JNCIA-CLOUD Training. The course modules will be available to you through the Juniper Learning Portal<https://learningportal.juniper.net/juniper/default.aspx> platform.



How to Access Learning Material?

1.     If you are a first time participant, please create an account at learningportal.juniper.net<https://learningportal.juniper.net/juniper/default.aspx>.



For assistance refer this video - Juniper Learning Portal Registration and Login Instructions<https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=E5vuvPyMHjU&feature=youtu.be>.



PLEASE NOTE: Do not select option "Access to EngNet, vLabs & other JCL tools

If you already have an account, please login with your credentials.


JNCAA - Cloud, Associate (JNCIA-Cloud)
https://learningportal.juniper.net/juniper/admin_activity_info.aspx?id=11915





2.     Click here to navigate to the Juniper Learning Portal and access your course learning material.


3.     On Juniper Learning Portal homepage, scroll down to 'Green Ribbon' and Click on the Course Link available next to 'Start Training Now'


[cid:image004.png@01DCDC94.77AAE030]


































4.     Click 'Subscribe'-->[cid:image005.jpg@01DCDC94.77AAE030] --> 'Checkout'-->[cid:image006.jpg@01DCDC94.77AAE030] --> 'Purchase'-->[cid:image007.jpg@01DCDC94.77AAE030] --> 'Continue'-->[cid:image008.jpg@01DCDC94.77AAE030]



PLEASE NOTE: You will NOT be charged. The course is 100% FREE.


You should now see the Full Course Outline: E-Learning Modules & Voucher Assessment Test


For issues related to Learning Portal account or lab access, please reach out to Juniper Customer Care by phone: 1-888-314-5822 (toll free, US & Canada). All other global Customer Care phone numbers can be found here https://support.juniper.net/support/requesting-support/ (NOTE the region tabs across the top of the page for global contact numbers).



Free Certification Voucher:

To receive a free certification voucher with 75% discount to take exam, you must complete three tasks listed below:

1.     Open and read the 'Read Me' file

2.     Complete all of the course modules

3.     Achieve a score of 70% or greater on the Voucher Assessment Test

a)     you have a maximum of three attempts to achieve the 70% score


Distribution of Vouchers:

*       You will have three total attempts to pass the voucher assessment test.

*       Upon successful completion of voucher assessment test if you score 70% or higher, a Pearson Vue discount voucher code will be emailed to you for the actual written certification exam.

*       You may also find the voucher code under your Training History<https://learningportal.juniper.net/juniper/user_transcript.aspx>. There are no exceptions to the number of attempts. The voucher code is only valid for a maximum of 30 days. You must schedule and complete your exam<https://home.pearsonvue.com/junipernetworks/onvue> within the 30-day window. Voucher extensions or replacements will not be provided.

*       Vouchers can only be used via Remote Online Proctor<https://home.pearsonvue.com/Clients/Microsoft/Online-proctored.aspx> option.



Post Certification Badge on Social Media:

Don't Forget to post your Certified badge to the Juniper Networks Certification Group on LinkedIn<https://www.linkedin.com/groups/1878403?lipi=urn%3Ali%3Apage%3Ad_flagship3_groups_entity%3BgX2F4QgqQ06H0%2BcgLn1Vyw%3D%3D&licu=urn%3Ali%3Acontrol%3Ad_flagship3_groups_entity-feed_list_group>!

N.B: Students that attain a certification will have the opportunity to be put forward for graduate roles within Juniper and our wider partner community.

Check for JNCAA the FAQ's here<https://juniper-training.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/360058452353-JNCAA-Frequently-Asked-Questions>

Submit your JNCAA Support Ticket here<https://juniper-training.zendesk.com/hc/en-us>

Please let me know if you have any questions -- Happy Learning!
Best Regards,
The JNCAA Program Managers
